title: Sleep Apnea. Concordance Between Non-reference and Reference Centres
brief_summary: When a disorder is as prevalent as sleep apnea hypopnea syndrome various medical levels and strategies should be implicated. We to evaluate the degree of concordance in management between a sleep reference centre and non-reference centres.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Supected sleep apnea

Exclusion Criteria:

* Major diseases
